name: hris-team-directory
context: Design an employee directory interface for an HRIS application. The audience is HR managers and employees searching for team members, viewing org charts, and accessing contact information. Target platforms: desktop and mobile responsive. Must support grid and list view, search/filter by department, and employee profile quick view.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for employee names, titles, and department labels
Apply color.rules.json for department color coding and status indicators
Use layout.rules.json responsive grid (3-4 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile)
Employee cards must show avatar, name, role, and department at minimum
Search and filter controls must have proper form semantics
Grid items must be keyboard navigable with clear focus indicators

outputCriteria.format: Page layout spec with directory grid, search/filter bar, and employee card design
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens
Employee cards use consistent spacing and alignment
Search results update with clear count announcement
Grid adapts to responsive breakpoints properly
accessibilityRequirements: Employee cards are keyboard navigable as a grid
Avatar images have alt text with employee name
Search results count announced via aria-live
Department filter uses proper combobox or listbox role
Quick view modal manages focus correctly

examples.description: Employee directory card with avatar and contact info
examples.output:
Molecule: EmployeeCard
  Layout: flex(direction: column, align: center, gap: var(--space-sm))
  bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
  border: var(--border-default)
  radius: var(--radius-lg)
  padding: var(--space-lg)
  Children:
    - Atom: Avatar(size=lg, radius=var(--radius-full), alt='Employee Name')
    - Atom: Text(role=heading, level=3, token=typography.body.md, weight=medium, color=color.text.primary)
    - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.secondary, content='Job Title')
    - Atom: Badge(label='Department', variant=subtle, color=department-semantic)
    - Molecule: ContactActions(layout=flex, gap=var(--space-xs))
        - Atom: Button(icon=mail, variant=ghost, size=sm, aria-label='Email Employee Name')
        - Atom: Button(icon=phone, variant=ghost, size=sm, aria-label='Call Employee Name')
  States: default, hover(shadow: var(--shadow-md)), focus(outline: var(--color-focus-ring))
acceptanceCriteria: Uses semantic tokens for all styling
Department badge uses semantic color variant
